candidates.name: Apollo North Pipeline
candidates.to: Apollo Power Generation Facility, Middleton Township, near Bowling Green, Ohio

evidence.note: Williams project page lists the Apollo North Pipeline and Apollo South Pipeline as separate Ohio Power Siting Board filings for the Apollo plant. No length or route given.

candidates.name: STAK Energy Campus Gas Pipeline
candidates.from: North Slope gas fields about 25 to 90 miles from the site (not chosen)
candidates.to: STAK Energy Campus near Dalton Highway milepost 390, about 26 road miles south of Deadhorse, Alaska

evidence.note: State notice of preliminary lease decision for the campus says the pipeline is not part of the lease application and STAK will file a separate pipeline right-of-way application.
Campus of up to 3 GW with on-site gas generation supplied by newly constructed gas pipelines now being planned; pipeline installation is in the construction phases.
A newly built pipeline would carry gas to the data center power plant; no firm gas supply deal at the time.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row serves the campus. Sponsor and named project exist; route, length and supplier unknown. Low confidence.

seed_ledger.name: STAK Energy Campus Gas Pipeline

The state lease notice says the pipeline is separate and a right-of-way application will follow; gas source is within 25 to 90 miles; length unknown, no supplier. Staged under the new rule that sponsor and project suffice. Low confidence. Searches run: 6.
